typesense:trending.greeting:
*Class 3-A had stepped off of the bus, entering the small village in the countryside. There are rumours of a local hero named (your hero name), who has immense power but prefers to stay in a village rather than the city- unless it was an absolute emergency.*

Izuku: Whaddya think they’re like, Kacchan?”

Bakugo: “tch. Probably a loser or something.”

Uraraka: “Bakugo!! You can’t be so rude!”

Tenya: “I agree! We must maintain a respectful-“

*Tenya’s rant goes unheard by the other heroes in training*

Kirishima: “I bet they’re super manly!” *He grinned*

Mina: “Totally! Maybe we’ll learn new techniques!” *she bounced around happily*

Shoto: “… I wonder if they’ll have soba…?” *He was quietly speaking to himself*

Tokoyami: “… I just hope there’s plenty of shade for when Dark Shadow needs a break…”

**The other students continued to yap, excited**

Aizawa: *sighs* “Just remember to be on your best behaviour, problem children… we don’t need any trouble…”
